items.t: Four-speed automatic slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,800–$2,250 typical; a torque converter alone runs about $2,000 installed.

items.t: Airbag light on from a failing clockspring or sensor
items.job: Diagnose airbag codes; replace clockspring
items.note: If an airbag sensor or module is at fault, parts cost more.

items.t: Rusted brake lines leak and cause sudden brake loss
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines and bleed brakes

items.t: Engine stalls while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; replace fuel pump module if weak
items.note: Diagnosis may find a sensor or wiring fault instead, which can cost less.

items.t: Headlights cut out briefly while driving
items.job: Diagnose headlight circuit; replace headlight switch or module

items.t: Instrument panel gauges or lights stop working
items.job: Repair or replace instrument cluster

items.t: Air conditioning blows warm or compressor fails
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, evacuate and recharge
items.note: An owner was quoted over $700 at a dealer. A simple leak repair costs less.

items.t: Power steering hose can leak and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering hose (recall)

items.t: Oil leak from the oil filter adapter
items.job: Replace oil filter adapter or its seal

items.t: Front clunk or rattle from sway bar links and bushings
items.job: Replace front sway bar links and bushings

items.t: Fuel rail leak with gas smell in the cabin
items.job: Replace fuel rail or injector O-rings
items.note: The single owner who reported this spent far more because of other problems on the same van.

items.t: Front lower control arm bolt can break (recall)
items.job: Replace control arm bolts (recall)

items.t: Radio short circuit can start a speaker fire (recall)
items.job: Radio recall repair

items.t: Sliding door lock linkage can let the door partly open (recall)
items.job: Sliding door lock linkage recall repair

items.t: Child seat attachment information missing (recall)
items.job: Child seat anchor and manual update (recall)

items.t: Some replacement brake master cylinders can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace recalled aftermarket master cylinder (parts maker recall)

items.t: Some replacement fuel filters can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace recalled aftermarket fuel filter (parts maker recall)

items.t: Harsh shifts or jerks from the nine-speed automatic
items.job: Scan, update transmission software and relearn shifts
items.note: If internal parts have failed, a valve body or transmission repair can reach about $9,000 out of warranty.

items.t: Ticking engine from worn rocker arms
items.job: Replace rocker arms and lifters on affected bank

items.t: Oil or coolant leak from the oil filter housing
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler seals

items.t: Ticking behind the dash from the recirculation door actuator
items.job: Replace HVAC recirculation door actuator
items.note: One owner paid about $350 at a dealer.

items.t: Clunk when lifting off the gas at low speed
items.job: Inspect and torque front axle nuts; check mounts

items.t: Stop/start unavailable or battery charging warnings
items.job: Test and replace auxiliary or main battery

items.t: Side curtain airbag connector may be loose (recall)
items.job: Secure side curtain airbag connector (recall)

items.t: Second-row seat latch can stick open (recall)
items.job: Inspect seat; replace cushion frame if needed (recall)

items.t: Rearview camera image may not display (recall)
items.job: Radio software update (recall)

items.t: Windshield wipers may not work properly (recall)
items.job: Wiper recall repair

items.t: Steering column module weld can stop the driver airbag (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering column control module (recall)

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not hold pressure (recall)
items.job: Replace side curtain airbags (recall)

items.t: Brake pedal sensor can disable stability control (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake pedal position sensor (recall)
